ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with a dominant low-intensity (black) central mask against high-intensity (white) lateral lobes at a macro ratio of approximately 2:3.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Centralized low-intensity region covering roughly 40% of the surface area centered at the median notch; high-intensity lateral zones containing dense mid-intensity (grey) mottling and distinct dark linear streaks.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, rounded U-shaped notch; interior angle estimated at approximately 55 degrees with a vertical depth of roughly 15% of the fluke's longitudinal height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular trailing edge boundary characterized by high-frequency, variable-amplitude serrations; peak-to-valley amplitude is most pronounced on the distal sections of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strong upward convexity observed on the outer margins of both lobes, curving from a horizontal orientation toward the midline to a vertical orientation at the tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular high-intensity (white) clusters detected within the low-intensity central region; scattered dark circular spots present on the inner white regions of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct, unaligned dark linear streaks (rake marks) oriented diagonally across the high-intensity white surfaces of both the left and right lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense, high-intensity textured cluster corresponding to sessile organisms (barnacles) localized at the extreme distal tip of the right lobe; significant irregular tissue loss on the trailing edge of the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced accumulation of barnacles at the right fluke terminus forming a unique high-contrast textured boundary.
